paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Avina. Rabbi Abba bar Zavda asked him (Shabbat 60b). Rav’s student. I have not found that he was Rav’s student; perhaps he is bar Mina, mentioned nearby. In the Jerusalem Talmud, end of Yoma: Rabbi Abba bar Bina; Rabbi Berekhiah, רבא [epithet uncertain], spoke in his name. Jerusalem Talmud, Sanhedrin, chapter 3, halakhah 3: Rava (meaning Rabbi Ba) bar Bina in Rav’s name. Rabbi Apotriki, brother of Rabbi Derosai, in his name. Chagra was his brother.
